reads_as: the same person framed twice in a blue-vs-green standoff with a giant painted VS splitting 'PROGRAMMING' from 'CODING'
layout_map: Dark room photo split into two color-graded halves inside a thin grey border. LEFT half cells 1-7 graded cold blue with a rim glow; same man seated at a MacBook looking down, head ~x270,y280, torso to bottom. RIGHT half cells 9-15 graded lime green with rim glow; same man chin-on-hand looking left, head ~x1020,y280. Headline 'PROGRAMMING' top-left in chunky white caps with purple outline+glow, baseline ~y95 across cells 1-6; 'CODING' top-right same style cells 11-15 baseline ~y95. A large white paint-stroke 'VS' (red speckle, ~280px tall) centered ~x640,y330 splitting the two halves. Three stacked rounded dark label chips bottom-left: 'MATH' (red), 'LOGIC' (teal), 'SYSTEMS' (white) at x70-240, y400/500/600. Two circular tech badges (CSS3 blue, HTML5 orange) stacked bottom-right ~x1180,y430/560.
why_it_works: the mirrored same-person split plus a violent VS stroke turns an abstract definition question into a head-to-head fight the eye must resolve
mimic_for: a video pitting two concepts our audience conflates against each other (e.g. authentication vs authorization, SQL vs NoSQL)
title: Programming vs Coding - What's the difference?

title: Why Most Google Employees Quit After 1.1 Years (On Average)
